components.description: Envoy-based reverse proxy for the various user-facing web interfaces.
Next.js webstore with a client-side application and an API layer exposing REST endpoints to backend services.
Locust-based generator that creates simulated HTTP and headless-browser traffic against the frontend.
Service that consumes new orders from a Kafka topic.
Service that provides advertisements based on context keys, or random ads when none are given.
Service that stores user shopping carts in Valkey.
Service that provides checkout functionality and publishes new orders to Kafka.
C++ service that converts amounts from one currency to another.
Service that sends the customer an order confirmation email by rendering it as a log message.
Service that receives new orders from a Kafka topic and flags cases suspected of fraud.
Service responsible for processing and validating payments.
gRPC service that serves the product catalog backed by PostgreSQL queries.
PHP service that calculates shipping costs based on the number of items.
Spring Boot service that recommends other products based on the currently selected product.
Rust service that gets price quotes, provides tracking IDs and simulates order fulfillment and shipping.
Message queue in KRaft mode connecting checkout with the accounting and fraud detection services.
Key-value store in which the cart service stores user shopping carts.
Relational database queried by the product catalog service.
Feature flag service that services query for flag values such as intlShippingSlowdown.
